candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.role_title: Working Student Digital & Analytics in Credit Risk (f/m/d)
letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position in Digital & Analytics in Credit Risk. Preparing and visualizing data to support risk management decisions in a major energy company is a strong fit with my experience and my M.Sc. in Data Science.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau. Before moving to Germany I worked as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea and in SAP data & analytics consulting at TallyMarks Consulting, building dashboards, data models and SQL-based reporting for business teams.

achievements.impact: I used SQL analysis, data validation and reconciliation to keep reporting accurate across HR, finance, supply chain and procurement
I replaced a quality check where users opened an SAP report for each of thousands of materials and compiled results in Excel with a single SAP Analytics Cloud dashboard
I documented data sources, calculations and results for every dashboard I built, so colleagues could support them too

letter.problems_section: In your team I would analyse, prepare and visualize data, support improvements to your central credit risk management system, and help with data management and documentation. I have not yet worked with your cloud database stack, but I learn new data platforms quickly.
letter.closing: I am available immediately for up to 20 hours per week and am happy to relocate to Essen. I would be glad to discuss how I can contribute.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
